name: Chemicals

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: Margin under pressure due to raw material volatility
mofsl_2qfy27.read: Revenue beat MOFSL estimates (AACL, ATPL, CLEAN, DN, FINE, GALSUF, NFIL and SRF beat), while EBITDA was in line with a beat from AACL, DN, FINE, GALSUF and NFIL; adj. PAT came in below estimates. Aggregate revenue grew 25% YoY to INR218.1b, EBITDA rose 13% to INR48.3b and adj. PAT grew 5% to INR20b. Gross margin contracted 290bp YoY and EBITDA margin 180bp YoY to 17.6%, with contraction at ATPL, CLEAN, ELLEN, PI, SRF, TTCH and VO. Guidance: Clean Science expanding HALS to 12,500 MTPA; Deepak Nitrite sees phenolics profit sustained in 3Q and a 14-15% EBIT margin in advanced intermediates by FY28; Ellenbarrie guides ~20% core gases growth; SRF chemical growth ~15-20% with specialty recovering in 2H; Vinati FY27 EBITDA margin ~24-25%; GALSUF raised full-year EBITDA/kg guide to INR26-27. No upgrades or downgrades.

unit_economics: EBITDA = volume x (realisation/kg - raw material/kg - conversion cost/kg); contracted and formula-priced products pass through input moves, spot products carry the spread; new plants earn margin only after utilisation passes breakeven.

price_drivers.driver: Spread between product price and raw material (gross margin)
price_drivers.why: Aggregate gross margin fell 290bp YoY in 2Q as raw material volatility (phenol, methanol, chloroform) outpaced contract pass-through; contracts reset with a 1-2 quarter lag.

price_drivers.driver: Utilisation of new capacity and project timing
price_drivers.why: CLEAN HALS, Navin HFO/R-32 lines, DN advanced intermediates and SRF specialty earn returns only at higher utilisation; slips defer EBITDA and add depreciation.
Chinese HQ, phenol and intermediate prices cap domestic price; anti-dumping duties (DGTR to MoF lag) restore it.
R-32 prices and the HFC freeze from 2028 plus HFO contract run-rate set Navin, SRF and GFL earnings.
Single customers above 10% of revenue (Navin three at 38.6%, CLEAN Kemin lock-in) make renewals binary for revenue.

kpis.name: Gross margin (material cost basis)
kpis.definition: Revenue less materials, purchases and change in stock, as a share of revenue.
kpis.formula: (Revenue - RM consumed - purchases +/- inventory change) / revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Gross margin shows pass-through before fixed costs blur it; the 290bp aggregate decline in 2Q is why ATPL, PI, SRF, TTCH and VO missed on EBITDA even with revenue up 25%.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (RM consumed, purchases, inventory change, revenue); get_investor_presentation metric filter 'gross margin'; broker results tables (Motilal Oswal 8 quarters).
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates gives Sales/EBITDA/PAT only: no gross margin consensus, so use broker models and management commentary.
kpis.traps: Two bases at some companies (after fuel or not); inventory gains and losses in volatile quarters; CFCL-type subsidiaries move gross margin 26-49%.

kpis.name: House EBITDA margin (ex other income, FX and one-offs)
kpis.definition: EBITDA on revenue from operations after removing other income, FX gains and named one-offs.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Aggregate margin fell to 17.6% (from 19.4% a year ago); margin versus guidance (Vinati 24-25%, Navin ~34%, NFIL, Ellenbarrie 40% long-term gases) drives re-rating more than revenue.
kpis.history_source: get_financials; get_investor_presentation metric filter 'EBITDA margin'; transcripts via get_qa for guidance; broker results notes.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates for Bloomberg Sales/EBITDA/PAT/EPS; margin guidance from company transcripts.
kpis.traps: Deck margins on sale of products versus total revenue; FX gains inside EBITDA (GFL Rs88.6cr FY26); promoter bonus reversals; SRF deck EBITDA includes other income.

kpis.name: Volume and price split of revenue growth
kpis.definition: Revenue growth separated into volume, realisation and mix, with new-platform contribution.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Revenue +25% YoY with EBITDA +13% shows volume or pass-through-led growth without spread; Navin's refrigerant gain was volume and mix QoQ, not price, while price-led gains reverse.
kpis.history_source: Transcripts via get_qa and search_research (volume/price bridge is call-only at CLEAN); get_investor_presentation metric filter 'volume'; get_financials segment revenue.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models and management guidance (Ellenbarrie ~20% gases growth, SRF 15-20%, Privi 20%); no consensus split.
kpis.traps: Segment series restated (CLEAN HALS inside performance chemicals); R-32 price quoted without a basis (domestic, China, export).

kpis.name: Capacity, utilisation and project milestones
kpis.definition: Installed capacity by product, utilisation on a stated denominator, and dated project commissioning versus guidance.
kpis.formula: Production / average commercial capacity; project date versus first guided date
kpis.why_it_moves_price: CLEAN HALS expansion to 12,500 MTPA, Navin R-32 and HFO plants and DN's EBIT target of INR4.0-4.2b in FY28 all rest on plant ramps; a slipped date moves EBITDA out a year while depreciation starts.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'capacity' or 'utilisation'; transcripts for commissioning dates; annual reports for capex and CWIP via read_library_document.
kpis.estimate_source: Management guidance in transcripts; broker models; no consensus field.
kpis.traps: Capacity quoted as par revenue rather than tonnes; 'commissioned' versus commercial; CWIP ageing over two years.

kpis.name: Refrigerant price (R-32/R-22) and quota position
kpis.definition: R-32 domestic, China and export price on a stated basis and capacity against estimated HFC quota entitlement.
kpis.formula: Reported price (Rs/kg or US$/kg); capacity / estimated quota
kpis.why_it_moves_price: R-32 prices up ~27-49% YoY lifted fluoro earnings, but India R-32 capacity of 113-152 kt against 17-20 kt demand makes the 2027 free year a price risk; Kotak values R-32 earnings at 7x.
kpis.history_source: Broker weekly notes in the library (Kotak 'Chemical Reactions', IDBI, Equirus); transcripts for contracted share; company decks via get_investor_presentation 'refrigerant'.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; broker price decks and company guidance only.
kpis.traps: Basis (domestic vs export ~30-35% lower) must be stated; quota estimates are analyst figures.

kpis.name: Key input price (phenol, methanol, acetone, chloroform) and China prices
kpis.definition: Price of the dominant input and the competing Chinese product price.
kpis.formula: Tracked price in Rs/kg or RMB/t
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Phenol rose from Rs101/kg to Rs180/kg in Feb-Sep 2026 and CLEAN gross margin fell 456bp YoY in 1QFY27; the input move reaches margin within the quarter and price 1-2 quarters later.
kpis.history_source: get_commodity_prices for crude derivatives where available; broker sector notes (Kotak weekly, IDBI monthly, 360 ONE) in the library.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; Kotak commodity forward assumptions via get_commodity_assumptions for a house view.
kpis.traps: Company quotes may be landed or China domestic; no public price series for MEHQ, HALS, HQ.

kpis.name: Customer concentration and contract run-rate
kpis.definition: Revenue share of top customers and annualised value of long-term contracts (HFO, CDMO, innovator agro).
kpis.formula: Top-3 customers' revenue / total revenue; contract value / years
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Navin's three customers at 38.6% and the Solstice extension at ~US$45mn a year versus ~US$59mn originally show how contract terms change the earnings base; CLEAN's Kemin deal raises concentration.
kpis.history_source: Annual report notes via read_library_document (customers above 10%); transcripts via get_qa; get_investor_presentation for contract disclosures.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models and management statements; no consensus field.
kpis.traps: Customers unnamed; contract value lumps incl. pass-through; extension years versus original run-rate.

macro_inputs.series: Phenol, methanol, acetone, crude, natural gas
macro_inputs.source: Airavat get_commodity_prices; Kotak commodity assumptions via get_commodity_assumptions

macro_inputs.series: China chemical prices (R-32, HQ, PTFE, phenol)
macro_inputs.source: Broker weekly notes in the library (Kotak, Dolat, IDBI)

macro_inputs.why: Trade remedy timing for protected products
Export realisation; exports are ~61% of CLEAN revenue

valuation_anchor: P/E on core EPS plus net cash against own band (Nifty Chemicals ~40x) for niche names; EV/EBITDA by module (SOTP) for fluorochemical groups; regime split between pre-FY26 scarcity premium and contested-moat valuations.
watch_next_quarter: Per MOFSL, margins stay exposed to raw material volatility into 3Q: track pass-through of phenol and methanol, DN phenolics profit sustaining in 3Q, SRF specialty volume recovery in 2H, Galaxy's raised INR26-27/kg EBITDA guide, CLEAN HALS ramp and global soda ash weakness for Tata Chemicals.
